Name: Realistic Items 2
Author: wwwfruity
Description:
Are you tired of the game's cartoonish style? Do you want to try something else? This mod is your solution!

Realistic Items is a complete retexture of almost every item in the game, refreshing Stardew Valley with a more realistic look.

[size=4]CHANGES (everything is configurable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url])[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Artisan Goods[/size]
[*][size=3]Craftables (not machines)[/size]
[*][size=3]Crops and Forage[/size]
[*][size=3]Dishes and Cooking Ingredients[/size]
[*][size=3]Fishing and Sea Related[/size]
[*][size=3]Minerals (Foraged, Gems, Geodes and Geodes Minerals)[/size]
[*][size=3]Qi's Walnut Room Items[/size]
[*][size=3]Quest Items[/size]
[*][size=3]Resources[/size]
[*][size=3]Seeds, Saplings and Tree Seeds[/size]
[*][size=3]Trash[/size]
[*][size=3]Treasures[/size]
[*][size=3]UI Elements (Skills, Money and other things)[/size]
[*][size=3]Wallet Items[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]TO-DO LIST[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Artifacts[/size]
[*][size=3]Books[/size]
[*][size=3]Fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Giant Crops[/size]
[/list][size=3]
REMINDER: This mod is completely made with free resources and pictures from internet. I used Photopea to make, edit and resize all sprites.[/size]
